sources.source: (let [m {1 :int 1.0 :float}] [(count m) (get m 1) (get m 1.0) (contains? m 1) (contains? m 1.0) (vec (seq m)) (vec (keys m)) (vec (vals m))])
(let [m '{1 :int 1.0 :float} s '#{1 1.0}] [(count m) (get m 1) (vec (seq m)) (count s) (vec (seq s))])
(let [x [{:m {1 :int 1.0 :float} :s #{1 1.0}}] m (get (first x) :m) s (get (first x) :s)] [(count m) (get m 1) (count s) (vec (seq s))])

(let [m {1 :int 1M :decimal 1.0 :float} s #{1 1M 1.0}] [(count m) (get m 1) (vec (seq m)) (count s) (vec (seq s))])
(let [m {##Inf :pos ##-Inf :neg ##NaN :nan} s #{##Inf ##-Inf ##NaN}] [(count m) (get m ##Inf) (get m ##-Inf) (contains? m ##NaN) (count s) (contains? s ##Inf) (contains? s ##NaN) (vec (seq s))])
(let [m {1 :int 1.0 :float ##NaN :nan} s #{1 1.0 ##NaN}] [(count m) (get m 1) (count s) (vec (seq s)) (contains? s ##NaN)])

(let [events (atom []) m {1 (do (swap! events conj :first) 11) 1.0 (do (swap! events conj :second) 22)} output (with-out-str (println (count m)) (println (get m 1)))] [(count m) (get m 1) (vec (seq m)) @events output])
(let [events (atom []) s #{(do (swap! events conj :first) 1) (do (swap! events conj :second) 2)} output (with-out-str (println (count s)))] [(count s) @events output])
(let [a 1 b 1.0 m {a :int b :float}] [(count m) (get m a) (get m b) (vec (seq m))])
